task: Propose and prototype CreateMutexA (ANSI) shim as a thin adapter over the existing wide-char mutex family (CreateMutexW path). UE4SS.dll imports CreateMutexA per census; it is currently unbound.

deliverables: mb_win_mutex_abi_a_shim.diff (integration diff: binder entry + shim function)

design_summary: CreateMutexA(lpMutexAttributes, bInitialOwner, lpName) converts the CP_ACP ANSI name to UTF-16 by zero-extending each byte (PS5 target has no locale/ACP tables; CP_ACP byte->WCHAR cast is the specified conversion), then delegates to the existing wide-char CreateMutexW implementation. NULL name stays NULL. Buffer is stack/heap-free via fixed-size local when name fits, else error like the W path.
constraints: No nested subagents, no network, proposal-only under worker dir; canonical sources untouched.
